text_blocks.snippet: The first military coup in Nigeria took place on January 15, 1966. It was led by Major Kaduna Nzeogwu and other junior officers, but they were unsuccessful in seizing power. Major General Johnson Aguiyi-Ironsi, the Commander in Chief of the Army, assumed control the following day. This coup and its aftermath had a significant impact on Nigeria's political landscape and ethnic relations.
